title: Page 96
transc:
Warrenton Nov 10 2 PM 
Confidential through Eckert For Doctor John
Asia Walnut st near 11th Legend
I leave here in the morning
& expect to be at the 
Continental tomorrow night late see me
there the next morning I may
remain the day in Leghorn Nelly
will join me there I am
taking leave of the stanhope today
& the scene surpasses description I
can not describe to you the
agony we all feel at our
separation Time will make all right
Adam Hannah ans if all right
